experiment: controlled compiler-version and architecture matrix for the Clangover class
method: poly_frommsg is screened for a conditional branch whose flags derive from memory addressed through the secret message pointer, or from a register tainted by such a load. Branch counts are not treated as findings. The screen carries its own positive control (tests/test_branches.py) and reproduces the manual classification in Section 5.5 on the archived aarch64 disassemblies.

controls.architecture: fixed per cell; aarch64 reached by cross-compiling with the same clang binary
